transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As Dr. Brooks conducts this review meeting, I want to make sure we address any implementation requirements from each participating school function before the plan is finalized. I have some information from the teacher work agreement that I'd like to share regarding preparation sessions and the student launch timeline.
transcript.speaker: A5

transcript.text: I've reviewed the publisher's current license, and I need to flag a critical implementation requirement. The license requires one individually assigned digital account per student and one authorized print copy per student. It permits 96 print copies for this cohort, but it does not permit shared classroom-code access. This means the draft plan's proposal of 80 printed copies and shared classroom-code digital access would put us out of compliance with the license terms.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical implementation requirement from the multilingual services side. My enrollment review identified 14 students who require the Arabic version of the materials, in addition to students who use the Spanish version. The publisher has confirmed that both Spanish and Arabic editions are available for this resource, but the language-service request has not yet been added to the adoption plan. The current draft plan only includes English-only materials, so we need to incorporate the Spanish and Arabic editions before this plan is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical implementation requirement from the classroom instruction side. During my spring pilot with the incoming cohort, I found that the Pathways Grade 6 edition repeats material these students have already mastered, while the Pathways Grade 7 edition matches the required seventh-grade sequence. I recorded these pilot results in my planning notes but have not yet sent them to the curriculum office. The draft plan currently proposes the Grade 6 edition, which based on my pilot findings would not be the right fit for our seventh-grade students.
transcript.speaker: A2

decisions.digital_access_model: Individually assigned digital accounts, one per student

commitments.detail: Update the adoption plan to specify Pathways Grade 7 edition instead of Grade 6, based on Mr. Grant's pilot findings.
Increase print copies from 80 to 96 to meet the one-print-copy-per-student license requirement.
Replace shared classroom-code digital access with individually assigned digital accounts for all 96 students, per license terms.
Add Spanish and Arabic language editions to the materials order to serve multilingual students, including the 14 students requiring Arabic and students requiring Spanish.
Request that pilot planning notes be formally submitted to the curriculum office for the record.
